description: The upper key boundary, and the twin of case03: exactly one record, at the highest CARD-NUM the fixture holds. case03 seeds zero-based row 0 and this seeds zero-based row 49, so the pair pins the first and the last record of a fifty-row key range that carddata.txt holds in ascending order with all fifty keys distinct - 0500024453765740 at the bottom, 9805583408996588 here at the top - and asserts nothing in between. WHAT THE PAIR PROVES: CBACT02C CONTAINS NO KEY-VALUE-DEPENDENT BRANCH, so the highest key must behave exactly as the lowest does. Read :70-87 and then :92-116 and there is no comparison against a key value, no range test, no HIGH-VALUES sentinel and no first-or-last special case anywhere in the program: every condition it has is on CARDFILE-STATUS at :94, :98, :121 and :139, or on the two 88-levels over APPL-RESULT - APPL-AOK at :104 and APPL-EOF at :107 - or on END-OF-FILE at :74-77; the one test left, IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC OR IO-STAT1 = '9' at :162-163, is a status test too and is reached only from an error arm this case never takes. The program displays whatever it reads. That is exactly why the boundary is worth two cases and not one: if a translation ever acquires a boundary condition the source does not have - a browse that stops one record short at the top of the range, an at-or-after positioning that steps past the final record, an off-by-one that reports end-of-file one record early or one record late - then case03 still passes and only case04 fails. A mid-file case would catch neither end, and case01 would report the same defect as one line missing out of fifty-two. THE ROW: zero-based row 49, key 9805583408996588. Its CARD-ACCT-ID is 00000000040 while row 0's is 00000000050, which is worth stating because it shows the file is ordered by card number and by nothing else - :32 declares RECORD KEY IS FD-CARD-NUM and :31 ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, so the last record means last by CARD-NUM, never last by account id. The row is seeded from the fixture rather than written inline so that its bytes stay the authoritative ones and the expected line is that same row verbatim; that the displayed line is the row itself and not a re-encoding of the six decoded fields is the property case18 isolates. THE UNIT, AND THE NAME THAT MISDESCRIBES IT: the unit under test is account.AccountBalanceReaderJob - an Account-named class in the account package - yet CBACT02C reads the CARD file and never touches the account file. :29-33 is SELECT CARDFILE-FILE ASSIGN TO CARDFILE, ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED, ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL, RECORD KEY IS FD-CARD-NUM, over an FD of FD-CARD-NUM X(16) plus FD-CARD-DATA X(134) = 150, and :45 is COPY CVACT02Y. AAP rule R1 governs - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and the divergence is catalogued in the register at AAP 0.8.4. A reviewer who trusts the class name authors the wrong case. THE RUN is :70-87 exactly once. :71 displays the start banner. :72 performs 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN, whose OPEN INPUT at :120 reports '00', so :121 takes its first arm and :126-127 CONTINUE. :74-81 then performs UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y': the first READ at :93 lands on the CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' arm at :94 and :78 displays CARD-RECORD - the 01 group item, so the whole 150-byte area including FILLER. The second READ reports '10', :99 moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, :107 finds the 88-level APPL-EOF true and :108 moves 'Y' into END-OF-FILE, so the loop ends without a second display. 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE reports '00' at :139, :140 SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT leaves zero, the end banner follows at :85, and GOBACK at :87 leaves RETURN-CODE 0. In repository terms the sequence is startBrowse '00', then readNext '00' delivering the record, then readNext '10' at end of file, then endBrowse '00' (gate G47). The job is driven at tasklet/step level, with no JobLauncher and no HTTP in the path (gate G51). MESSAGE ARITHMETIC: 1 start banner + 1 record image + 1 end banner = 3 ordered DISPLAY_LINE entries, of 38, 150 and 36 characters - the same count and the same two banner texts as case03, which is the shape invariance the pair exists to hold down. Exactly one image per record, because the DISPLAY inside the read paragraph at :96 is a COMMENT and no separate display paragraph exists, so :78 is the only live display - one line per record, never CBACT01C's thirteen lines per record nor CBACT03C's two identical ones. RECORD GEOMETRY, taken mechanically from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy (RECLN 150), one-based and cumulative so a reviewer can check this file against the copybook without running anything: CARD-NUM X(16) at 1-16 and also the RECORD KEY, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) at 17-27, CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) at 28-30, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) at 31-80, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) at 81-90 - carrying the copybook's own misspelling, never corrected - CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) at 91, and FILLER X(59) at 92-150. 16+11+3+50+10+1+59 = 150 (gate G19). This row decomposes to 9805583408996588, then 00000000040, then 908, then 'Davon Emmerich' followed by 36 spaces, then 2023-10-27, then Y, then 59 spaces - so the image ends in 59 significant spaces which must not be trimmed (gate G21). The copybook declares no COMP-3, no PACKED-DECIMAL and no S9, so every numeric span is unsigned zoned DISPLAY and there is no sign overpunch to model on this path. WIRING: app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:22 is a bare //STEP05 EXEC PGM=CBACT02C and the job declares no PARM anywhere, so jobParameters is empty; its single //CARDFILE DD at :25-26 is the only dataset seeded, addressed by the CARDFILE binding key that application.yml resolves at record-length 150 and never by a dataset name, so no DSNAME literal appears in this file (gate G46). ENCODING is US-ASCII, named explicitly rather than left to a platform default. NOTHING IS WRITTEN: expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because :120 opens INPUT and the program contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE - SYSOUT at READCARD.jcl:27 is its only output - and no normalisation is declared, because carddata.txt rows are already the full 150 bytes CVACT02Y declares; the one fixture-to-copybook width deviation on record is cardxref.txt's 36-byte rows, and it touches no dataset this case seeds. PROVENANCE: every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy for each offset and width, app/jcl/READCARD.jcl for the step and DD contract, and the real app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt for the seeded row. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: AAP 0.7.6 proves that impossible in this environment with eight independently verified blockers - no z/OS runtime, the available compiler's indexed file handler disabled, subprogram linkage that cannot be made executable, a copybook that will not parse, no Language Environment CEE services, no CICS emulator plus three absent IBM copybooks, EBCDIC fixtures needing binary handling, and no alternative compiler installable - and the substitution is recorded as risk R-A. The last record in, three lines out, RETURN-CODE 0.
